import numpy as np

    t = feature_cols.index(target_col)
    w = feature_cols.index("Wspd")
    # Diurnal profile: average power per 10-min step in a 24h cycle

    cycle = train_series[target_col].values.reshape(-1, 144).mean(axis=0)
    cycle_preds = np.tile(cycle, output_len // 144 + 1)[:output_len]
    
    # Wind speed based steady state
    bins = np.linspace(0, 20, 20)
    bin_idx = np.digitize(train_series["Wspd"], bins)
    curve = [train_series[target_col][bin_idx == i].mean() for i in range(len(bins) + 1)]
    curve = np.nan_to_num(curve, nan=train_series[target_col].mean())
    steady = np.interp(history_windows[:, -1, w], bins, curve[:len(bins)])
    
    # Blend: Persistence (last_p), Steady (Wspd), and Cyclical (Time of day)
    last_p = history_windows[:, -1, t]
    decay = np.exp(-0.015 * np.arange(output_len))
    
    # Combine: weighted average of components
    preds = (last_p[:, None] * decay[None, :] + 
             steady[:, None] * 0.4 * (1 - decay[None, :]) + 
             cycle_preds[None, :] * 0.6 * (1 - decay[None, :]))
    return np.clip(preds, 0.0, None)
